one_month_reasoning: AppLovin's own Q3 2026 report is not confirmed but is expected in early-to-mid November (TipRanks estimate ~Nov 11; last year early Nov), so it most likely falls just after the 2026-10-31 window; the class-action lead-plaintiff deadline (Nov 16) is also outside. Inside the window: Meta Q3 earnings (late Oct, read-through on ad demand and Audience Network), possible pre-earnings channel checks (Edgewater-type notes, Store Leads merchant counts) and continued law-firm press releases, which are noise. The stock just fell 7 straight sessions (-12%) to a 52-week low; short-term reversal after a sharp drop is roughly offset by negative momentum and falling estimate revisions, so I stay near neutral: median ~$282 (spot), lognormal with monthly vol ~21% (75%/3.5). Slightly fatter downside than upside in practice is ignored because the left skew from momentum is balanced by oversold reversal.

fair_value.method: Blend of NTM P/E ($22 NTM EPS at Oct-2027 x 16 = $352, 45%), EV/NTM EBITDA ($9.2B x 11 = $309/sh, 30%) and FCF yield ($21.2 NTM FCF/sh at 6% = $354 hair-cut to $330, 25%) = ~$334, i.e. ~19% above spot, using consensus trimmed ~5% for the industry evidence of share saturation and spread compression.

methods.name: P/E
methods.inputs: NTM EPS at Oct-2027 ~$22 (FY2027 EPS $19 haircut from $20.00 consensus, ~16% growth into 2028) x 16x

inputs_detail.value: $20.00 (27 analysts; was $21.16 60 days ago; 19 down vs 5 up revisions in 30d)

inputs_detail.derivation: 5% haircut to consensus: Edgewater checks show MAX share near a ceiling and net revenue spreads compressing from Unity competition; Unity guides Vector +19-21% QoQ; partly offset by Sensor Tower showing APP iOS share rising to 44% and Citi/Store Leads merchant growth.
FY2027 $19 rolled forward ~3 quarters at ~16% growth (consensus FY26->FY27 EPS growth is 28%; I assume continued deceleration), plus ~3% share-count shrink from buybacks ($551M/qtr in Q2).

Stock now trades ~14x FY2027 consensus; 16x reflects ~20% EPS growth and 80%+ EBITDA margins, discounted for litigation overhang and growth-saturation debate; below the ~25-30x the stock carried before the selloff (mean target fell $654->$498) and above small peer Liftoff's ~7x EV/EBITDA IPO valuation.

methods.name: EV/EBITDA
methods.inputs: NTM EBITDA at Oct-2027 ~$9.2B x 11x = EV $101B; net debt ~$0.5B; ~325M shares

inputs_detail.derivation: FY2027 EBITDA = $10.26B x 0.82 = $8.4B, haircut 5% to $8.0B for spread compression, rolled forward ~3 quarters at ~15-18% growth.
Current EV ~$95B is ~11x FY2027 consensus EBITDA; Liftoff IPO'd at ~7x 2026E EBITDA ($3.66B / ~$514M guide) with slower growth and lower margins; 11x keeps today's multiple on forward numbers.
335M outstanding at Q2 2026 less ~10M from buybacks at ~$2B+/yr pace ($551M in Q2) net of SBC.

methods.name: FCF yield
methods.inputs: NTM FCF at Oct-2027 ~$6.9B (75% of EBITDA) / 325M sh = $21.2/sh at ~6.3% yield

inputs_detail.derivation: Management expects FY FCF conversion to normalize to ~75% of adjusted EBITDA.
TIKR cites NTM levered FCF yield ~6% at $311 (vs ~2% at end-2025); I require a slightly higher yield than today's given decelerating growth and competition.

bear.story: Industry checks prove right: MAX share has topped out, Unity Vector (Grow +68-70% guided) and Liftoff/Moloco compress take rates, gaming ad spend grows only high-single digits, e-commerce self-serve scales slowly, AI video tool still delayed. Revenue growth falls to ~15-20% in 2027, FY27 EPS ~$16 (consensus low), market pays ~11x NTM; lawsuit headlines persist.

base.story: Q4 grows ~8-9% QoQ (mid-30s YoY), 2027 revenue ~+22-25% with 82% EBITDA margins; e-commerce advertisers keep adding (Store Leads/Jefferies) but gaming share is flat. FY27 EPS ~$19, re-rates modestly to ~15-16x NTM as estimate cuts stop.

bull.story: Self-serve Axon and the generative AI video tool ship and e-commerce becomes a second engine (non-gaming market 5-10x gaming); share gains vs Meta/Google continue as in Jefferies survey; growth re-accelerates to 30%+, FY27 EPS ~$22.5, multiple back to ~20x NTM.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$185 the stock would trade ~9x FY2027 consensus EPS and ~7x EBITDA, roughly the small-cap Liftoff multiple; that would most likely mean an actual fundamental break (QoQ revenue decline, guided take-rate/net revenue spread collapse from Unity/Google competition, an accounting or regulatory finding beyond the existing class action, or loss of a major MAX supply relationship) rather than ordinary 75%-vol noise.

reasoning: Starting point: $281, down 61% in a year after a Q2 miss ($1.924B vs ~$1.94B), Q3 guide of +46-48% YoY, a class action and estimate cuts (FY27 EPS consensus $21.16 -> $20.00 in 60 days). At spot the stock is ~14x FY27 consensus EPS and ~11x EBITDA with ~84% EBITDA margins, so valuation is undemanding if growth holds in the 20s. My lane evidence is mixed-to-negative on share: Edgewater checks see MAX share at a ceiling and spreads compressing (Q4 +8-9% QoQ => mid-30s YoY), competitors are all growing faster than the gaming ad pool (Unity Vector +63% YoY with Q3 Grow guide +68-70%, Liftoff core ads +36%, Digital Turbine AGP +56%) while Sensor Tower puts gaming ad spend growth at only ~8% and downloads -12%, implying share is being contested. Positives: Sensor Tower network data shows APP still gaining iOS share (44%), Jefferies' advertiser survey shows APP taking e-commerce budget share from Meta/Google, Citi/Store Leads merchant counts accelerated in September, and Meta's Horizon game tools are a minor direct threat. Net: I trim consensus ~5% and value at ~$334 (P/E, EV/EBITDA, FCF yield). Scenarios 190/330/520 at 30/45/25 give a mean ~$335 but a median nearer $300 given right skew. Base rate: realized vol 75%; I use a lognormal with median ~$300 and sigma ~0.60 (below realized because valuation support near 14x EPS and buybacks damp the left tail, yet above a typical large cap), with a slightly fattened far-left tail for fraud/litigation risk. 1-month: no scheduled company event in window, so near-symmetric around spot at ~21% monthly vol. Research limited to ~18 searches/fetches; no option data consulted.
